introHtml: PL reusable straws combine the durability of polypropylene with the convenience of a reusable design, making them a smart choice for businesses that want to reduce single-use plastic waste. These straws are lightweight, dishwasher-safe, and available in a variety of colors, allowing you to imprint your logo in vibrant detail. Whether you're outfitting a corporate cafeteria, a coffee shop, or a trade show booth, custom PL reusable straws offer a practical giveaway that recipients will actually use daily. Pair them with a drawstring pouch for a complete branded set.
